_comment: Sweep 3 — short-leg delta. Default 0.15 puts shorts ~1.5 sigma OTM. Lower delta (0.10) = further OTM = lower premium but higher win-rate; higher delta (0.25, 0.30) = closer to ATM = more credit but more breaches. Critical for gdfl_v2 where the wider chain may have shifted the actual delta=0.15 strike. Cartesian 4x4 (CE x PE deltas, kept symmetric) = 4 configs only since deltas are linked.
